name: Iron Trident
description:
About This Game

Key Features

Prepare for a new era of armored combat. Iron Trident blends cutting-edge visuals, compelling tactical depth, and electrifying multiplayer competition into a modern tank warfare experience like no other. Grab the commander’s seat, rally your comrades, and unleash the might of mechanized warfare in Iron Trident. The frontlines await—are you ready to lead the charge?

1. Modern Tank Arsenal
Choose from a meticulously curated selection of the world’s most formidable contemporary tanks. Each model is faithfully rendered to capture every detail—from turret design to reactive armor plating—so you can wage war in style and power.

2. Realistic Battlefields
Engage in high-tension skirmishes across sprawling arenas inspired by real-world environments. Fight your way through dense urban landscapes, arid deserts, and treacherous mountain passes, each demanding its own tactical approach.

3. Deep Progression & Customization
Earn experience and rewards as you dominate the battlefield. Research new technologies, upgrade your tank’s performance, and personalize loadouts to suit your combat style. Tailor your arsenal with cutting-edge weapon systems, enhanced turrets, and unique camouflage patterns.

4. Immersive Gameplay Mechanics
Feel the thunder of every shot with authentic ballistic modeling and physics-driven damage. Positioning, armor angling, and map knowledge are critical—think on your feet or find yourself in the crosshairs of a more cunning opponent.

5. Strategic Team-Based Warfare
Coordinate with your squad to control key objectives, flank enemy positions, and call in powerful air support. Communication and strategy are essential, transforming each match into a white-knuckle test of leadership and reflexes.

6. Dynamic Weather & Day/Night Cycles
Adapt to shifting battle conditions as storms roll in or the sun sets on the horizon. Rain-soaked roads reduce traction, nighttime assaults limit visibility—every changing element forces you to constantly refine your tactics.
short_desc: Iron Trident is a modern multiplayer tank combat game built around fast team-based PvP battles. Position your vehicle, angle your armor, target weak points, coordinate with allies, and use powerful tank abilities like ATGMs and artillery support to dominate the battlefield.
